description: **Available immediately** **Fully Furnished** Laragh is an exceptional five-bedroom residence in Killiney, extending to approx 580 sqm, available to let immediately and presented to an impeccable standard throughout. The property offers generously proportioned and beautifully appointed accommodation, including a 2 reception rooms, 2 dining rooms, large high end kitchen, separate utility room , five large bedrooms and four bathrooms, with every aspect thoughtfully designed for comfortable modern living. In addition, the property benefits from a separate two-bedroom mews, providing excellent flexibility for guests, extended family or additional living space. Set in one of Dublin’s most sought-after residential locations, Laragh combines space, style and versatility in a truly outstanding rental opportunity.
